project.name: TCS Atlas Token Registry
project.description: Domain flow showing the governed work spine (SOP->SWK->WI->Checklist->Action Plan->LMS), registry governance, verification, and audit layers.

nodes.name: SOP Layer (Standard Operating Procedures)
nodes.summary: Top-level governance layer. SOPs define the project gates (A1: Contract Execution, A2: Job Setup, etc.). Mapped by atomics.bucket tokens in the registry (43 buckets).

nodes.name: SWK Layer (Standard Work)
nodes.summary: Standard work procedures derived from SOPs. Each SWK decomposes a gate bucket into executable work sequences. Linked to atomics.bucket tokens.

nodes.name: WI Layer (Work Instructions)
nodes.summary: Individual work instructions that implement SWK procedures. Mapped by atomics.task tokens in the registry (304 tasks). Each WI has a canonical artifact on disk.

nodes.name: Checklist Layer
nodes.summary: Verification checklists that validate WI completion. Each checklist item maps to one or more atomics.task tokens. Checklists are the quality gate within each work instruction.

nodes.name: Action Plan Layer
nodes.summary: Action plans that track remediation and forward work. Mapped by pulse.pilot_token tokens (10 pilot tokens). Action plans bridge from verification findings to LMS tracking.

nodes.name: LMS Layer (Learning Management System)
nodes.summary: Training and competency tracking layer. LMS records which personnel have completed training on specific WIs and SOPs. Closes the governance loop back to SOP compliance.

nodes.name: Token Registry Core
nodes.summary: The central registry containing 26,748 tokens with 53,317 aliases. Governs every layer of the work spine by providing canonical token resolution for all cited references. Includes the xref index for bidirectional lookup.

nodes.name: Verification + Watchdog Layer
nodes.summary: Continuous verification layer with corpus scans, smoke tests, and 6 watchdog snapshots. Validates that all 495 cited tokens resolve to canonical entries with artifacts on disk. The immune system of the token namespace.

nodes.name: BD5 Cross-Corpus Audit Layer
nodes.summary: BD5 audits that validate the graphify substrate across 6 corpora (11,944 nodes, 16,047 edges). Measures token coverage, catches missing graphs, and triggers same-tick remediation. The outer ring of the verification immune system.
